list.name: Gravity Distortion
list.description: Gravity is warped here: Flying types and Levitate are grounded for the first 5 turns of every battle.
list.counterplay: Lean on Ground and Electric-proof teammates, or finish fights fast.

list.name: Time-Scarred Ruins
list.description: Time runs backwards in these ruins: the slowest Pokémon moves first for the first 5 turns of every battle.
list.counterplay: Put your slow, bulky Pokémon in front, or use Trick Room yourself to turn it back.

list.name: Shadow Zone
list.description: A choking dust fills this zone: a sandstorm blows through every battle.
list.counterplay: Rock, Ground and Steel Pokémon are safe from it; weather-changing moves clear it.

list.name: Crystallized Cavern
list.description: Crystals glow with a soft mist: Misty Terrain protects grounded Pokémon from status and weakens Dragon moves.
list.counterplay: Use Fairy, Poison or Steel moves, or lean on damage instead of status.

list.name: Unstable Energy Site
list.description: Electric energy surges through the ground: Electric Terrain boosts Electric moves and keeps grounded Pokémon awake.
list.counterplay: Ground types are immune to the Electric moves; avoid relying on sleep.

list.name: Dimension Crack
list.description: A crack in the sky pulls the rain in: it rains in every battle.
list.counterplay: Fire moves are weaker and Water moves stronger; use Sun or Water-resistant Pokémon.
